rows.text: Ooh, it's you.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: It's me.
Ooh, it's you.
(Wave them away.)
Crrrk... For us to be calmly greeting each other for the first time without poking at our backs with a compass, nor pulling at each other's tails, I'm suddenly not used to this.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: What're you up to this time?
All lines of work need ample rest. This is the right Talanton granted all creatures of the world.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: So, as you can see... I'm taking a break.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: When have I ever pulled on your tail?
Our ancestor Zagreus once said: "One person is an entire world, one person's pulling means everyone's pulling."
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: During this period, we should turn over a new leaf and find a proper job. Got any recommendations?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Become an anti-theft ambassador.
Teach them to store their valuables in their cellars, so I won't have to rummage through the whole house while I'm at it. Good idea.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Become a bath mascot.
Phagousa and I enjoyed great relations back in the day. At their banquet, my compliments had everyone roaring with laughter.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Crrrkk... They'd be blackout drunk every time, then I'd steal away a pearl from the crest of the wave. She never noticed, and even thought the wave was balding.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Be a transport worker, Old Bart.
You still remember that? It's just moving things from one place to another. I bet I'd be great at it.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Clear skies, green grass, citizens out and about... Our ancestor Zagreus once said: "The slightest thought is a sin on an idle afternoon."
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Let's leave that matter aside for now and tell me what you wanted to talk about. I'll banter with you.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos
